name: External Interaction Transition Baseline
description: Every governed transition of a External Interaction passes through the Transition Engine, which records the transition, its actor and its authority badge.

conditions.statement: Every transition of a External Interaction governed by this Policy is applied by the Transition Engine with a recorded actor and authority badge.

requiredEvidence.title: External Interaction Transition Record
requiredEvidence.description: The transition record written by the Transition Engine when the External Interaction transition is applied.
